briefing: {PATRON} here, port administrator of {HERE}. The docking fee is due, and the harvest quota is short again.
An Anaconda is forging the harvest through the manifests, and it drags this port's numbers down with it. Hold it on your scanner — do not fire, I need it watched, not wrecked.
When it moves on, find the Fer-de-Lance that carries the false papers and end the run. A taxpayer with a berth expects results, not excuses.

watch.arrive: Hold the Anaconda at {TARGET} on your scanner, and hold your fire
watch.success: The Anaconda is marked, and the payout climbs by {PAY}
watch.fail: The Anaconda slipped away, and {PAY} slipped with it

chase.arrive: Destroy the Fer-de-Lance, last seen at {TARGET}
chase.success: The Fer-de-Lance is run down, and {PAY} is closer
chase.fail: The Fer-de-Lance broke off pursuit, and the case goes cold

trail.success: The trail closes at {TARGET}, and {PAY} is paid in full
trail.fail: The trail went cold, and {PAY} stays unpaid

dossier.lead: A tightbeam from {WORLD} carries {PATRON}'s demand for a word, sharp and unfriendly.

rumour.far: Traders near {WORLD} mutter that {PATRON} is hunting forged harvest papers again.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD} that the forger is still loose and time is short.

dossier.news: Port records at {WORLD} show {PATRON} still short of pilots for the harvest audit.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took the port administrator's contract for {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, {WORLD} had its proof, and the courier's run was over.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, {WORLD} still waited on proof that never came.

watch.success: On day {DAY}, the commander held the Anaconda steady on the scanner over {WORLD}.
watch.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the Anaconda was destroyed over {WORLD} before the watch was done.
watch.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the Anaconda jumped clear of {WORLD} before the watch was done.
watch.failed: On day {DAY}, the watch over {WORLD} lapsed, and the trail was lost.

chase.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the commander destroyed the Fer-de-Lance over {WORLD}.
chase.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance escaped {WORLD}, and the chase moved on.
chase.targetFled: On day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance fled {WORLD} rather than fight.
chase.failed: On day {DAY}, the chase past {WORLD} ran out of time.

trail.success: On day {DAY}, the commander docked at {WORLD} and closed the courier's trail.
trail.failed: On day {DAY}, the trail past {WORLD} went cold.
